measured_for: Thailand, whole country (private car up to 7 seats, taxed on engine cc)
note: 1,798 cc: 600 x 0.50 + 1,198 x 1.50 = 2,097 THB a year; years 1-5 full, years 6-8 at 90/80/70% -> 1,939.7 a year. Plus the roadworthiness test (about 200 THB at a private station) once, at the year-8 renewal, because cars of 7 years and over need it (200/8 = 25 a year; source road-tax-th-autospinn-inspection, a search-tool summary because the page returned 403). Hybrids are taxed on cc like petrol cars. Compulsory insurance (the PRB) is left out. The DLT's own tariff page could not be fetched; iTAX copies it.
quote: ส่วนเกิน 600 cc ถึง 1,800 cc

measured_for: Peninsular Malaysia, private saloon owned by an individual (Sabah and Sarawak pay less)
note: 1,798 cc: 200 + (1,798 - 1,600) x 0.40 = 279.20 MYR a year; flat in every year of the car's life. JPJ publishes the schedule as a PDF (its July 2026 upload carries the 2009 rates); BJAK copies it. No periodic inspection for a private car unless it changes hands. SUVs and MPVs (the Corolla Cross) use the non-saloon schedule: 300 + 0.30 x 198 = 359.40.

measured_for: Singapore, whole country (private car, 1,798 cc petrol hybrid)
note: LTA road tax for 1,601-3,000 cc: [475 + 0.75 x (1,798 - 1,600)] x 0.782 = 487.58 per six months, 975.15 a year (no age surcharge until year 11). The 1.8 hybrid's motor (about 53 kW) gives a lower power-based figure, and a petrol-electric car pays the higher of the two. Plus the periodic inspection: none under 3 years, then every 2 years, so 3 inspections in 8 years at about 68.67 SGD (source road-tax-sg-singsaver-inspection; another site says 68.04) = 25.75 a year. The COE and ARF are in the car's price.

measured_for: Japan, whole country (private white-plate car, 1.5-2.0 L, 1.0-1.5 t)
note: Automobile tax (prefecture) 36,000 JPY a year for 1.5-2.0 L, registered after 1 Oct 2019. Weight tax 22,500 JPY for the first 3 years = 7,500 a year, the catalogue's figure for the Corolla 1.8 Hybrid W x B (the base rate: no 'eco-car' cut applies to it). Official inspection fee 1,700 revenue stamp + 400 certificate = 2,100 at the shaken at years 3, 5 and 7 (3 x 2,100 / 8 = 787.50 a year; source road-tax-jp-bestcalendar-shaken). Left out: the one-off 75% green cut on the year-2 automobile tax (applies to qualifying hybrids until March 2028; not checked for this trim), dealer shaken service charges, and compulsory CALI insurance. The 13-year surcharge is beyond the 8 years.
quote: 自動車税 36,000円 自動車重量税 22,500円

measured_for: Taiwan, whole country (private small passenger car, 1,201-1,800 cc petrol)
note: Vehicle licence tax 7,120 TWD (1,201-1,800 cc, paid in April) + highway maintenance fee (formerly the fuel-use fee) 4,800 TWD (petrol, 1,201-1,800 cc, paid in July) = 11,920 a year; the same every year. Hybrids are not exempt (only battery-electric cars are). The licence-tax table is also in the Ministry of Finance's PDF (road-tax-tw-mof-table). Not included: the periodic vehicle inspection, which starts after the car's first years; its fee was not found.

measured_for: Hong Kong, whole territory (private car, 1,500-2,500 cc petrol)
note: Annual vehicle licence fee 7,498 HKD (petrol private car over 1,500 cc up to 2,500 cc; includes the levy shown in the Transport Department's form TD341, Feb 2026). Plus the annual examination, required once the car is 6 years old: 2 exams at 585 HKD in years 7 and 8 = 146.25 a year (fee from a MoneyHero price list, road-tax-hk-moneyhero-exam; the Transport Department's own table was not read). First registration tax is in the car's price.

measured_for: Vietnam, whole country (private car up to 8 seats; same in Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang)
note: Road-use fee (Decree 364/2025, from 1 Jan 2026): 36 months 4,320,000 + 24 months 3,000,000 + 24 months 3,000,000 + 12 months 1,560,000 = 11,880,000 VND over 96 months. Inspection cycle for a private car: first at 36 months, then every 24 months until 7 years, then yearly, so 3 inspections in 8 years at 250,000 VND (Circular 55/2022; source road-tax-vn-ketoananpha-dangkiem). Vietnam has no annual vehicle tax on cars; the registration fee is one-off. (11,880,000 + 750,000) / 8 = 1,578,750 a year.
quote: Xe chở người đến 8 chỗ (không kể chỗ của người lái xe) không hoạt động kinh doanh vận tải.

measured_for: Jakarta (DKI Jakarta provincial rate: first car 2%, no opsen; other provinces about 1.1% + 66% opsen)
note: PKB = 2% x 1.025 (sedan weight coefficient; 1.05 for an SUV) x NJKB. Taxable value (NJKB) is not the purchase price; the Pergub depreciation table was not found, so NJKB is taken as the car module's price (442,905,063 IDR) falling in a straight line to 50% at year 8: mean 0.78125 x price = 346,019,580 IDR; tax 7,093,401 a year. Left out: the SWDKLLJ road-accident levy (143,000 IDR, a compulsory insurance-type contribution), the 5-yearly plate fee. Thin: the base is assumed.

measured_for: South Korea, whole country (private passenger car, over 1,600 cc)
note: Automobile tax = cc x 200 KRW (over 1,600 cc) = 359,600 + 30% local education tax = 467,480 KRW in years 1-2; from year 3 it falls 5% a year (year 8: -30%). Mean over 8 years = 406,123. Hybrids pay on engine cc. Rates here are the standard rule read from a blog; wetax.go.kr was not reachable. The periodic inspection (first at 4 years, then every 2 years) is not included.

measured_for: Dubai (RTA; Abu Dhabi charges 350 + a 150 test)
note: Registration (mulkiya) renewal 350 + 20 Knowledge and Innovation = 370 AED a year (8 x 370; the first year is paid at registration). A new private car skips the technical test for 3 years; then each renewal needs a test, 150 + 20 = 170 AED, 5 tests in years 4-8. (8 x 370 + 5 x 170) / 8 = 476.25. No annual tax on the car itself; Salik tolls and insurance are not included. Fees read from a guide that cites RTA's pages.

measured_for: Oman, whole country (private car under 3 tonnes, 1,500 to below 3,000 cc)
note: Royal Oman Police registration renewal (mulkiya): 23 OMR a year for 1,500 cc to below 3,000 cc. Technical inspection (5 OMR extra) is only for private cars of 10 years, so none in the 8 years. The 18 OMR band is for engines under 1,500 cc.

measured_for: Georgia, Tbilisi rate (0.8% of market value); applies only if the couple's family income is over 100,000 GEL a year
note: Property tax on a passenger car: 0.8% of the value at 31 December of the previous year (Tbilisi), but only for families with income over 100,000 GEL (from 30 Sept 2026; it was 40,000). Value: the car module's price 100,185 GEL on a straight line to 50% at year 8, mean 78,270 -> 626 a year. Mandatory inspection: first 4 years after manufacture, then every 2 years, 60 GEL (source road-tax-ge-doberi-inspection), so 3 in 8 years = 22.50 a year. If the couple's income is under the threshold the figure is 22.50. Thin: whether foreign-source withdrawals count as 'family income' was not checked.
quote: The rate is 0.8 to 1 % of market value, 0.8 % in Tbilisi and Batumi.

measured_for: Morocco, whole country (petrol-electric hybrid, 8-10 fiscal hp)
note: Annual vignette (TSAVA): 0 MAD, because article 260-15 of the General Tax Code exempts hybrid cars. (The payment site mavignette.ma still lists hybrids at the petrol rate, 650 DH for 8-10 cv, 350 DH under 8 cv; if that is enforced, add that figure.) Mandatory technical inspection: the first within 6 months before the 5th anniversary, then yearly, 370 DH for 8-10 cv (road-tax-ma-autoactu-ct: 'entre 370 et 400 DH', first control five years after registration, then annual; NARSA yearly cycle: road-tax-ma-demarchesmaroc-ct), so 4 inspections in 8 years = 185 a year. Thin: the Corolla hybrid's fiscal horsepower was assumed to be 8-10 cv, and the 370 DH tariff is a press figure (the official NARSA grid page is built by script and could not be saved).
quote: L'article 260-15° du CGI exonère les véhicules à moteur électrique ainsi que les véhicules à moteur hybride

measured_for: Cape Town (Western Cape tariff from 1 July 2026; Gauteng charges R732 + 72 for the same tare band)
note: Annual motor vehicle licence fee, tare 1,251-1,500 kg: R690 (Western Cape Provincial Gazette Extraordinary 9248, 9 June 2026) + R72 national transaction fee on every renewal = R762. No roadworthiness test for a private car except when it is sold. Left out: the one-off registration fee (R310) and the first-year disc, which is part of buying the car. The R72 fee is on easynatis.co.za/fees (road-tax-za-easynatis); the WC fee also appears in thesouthafrican.com (road-tax-za-thesouthafrican).

measured_for: Mexico City (Ciudad de México plates)
note: Tenencia (annual vehicle ownership tax): 0, because electric and hybrid cars are exempt in Mexico City (the car's invoice value, about 678,000 MXN here, is also above the 638,000 MXN cap for the general subsidy). Refrendo 2026: 760 MXN, 'preliminary cost'. Emissions verification: hybrids get the free 'Exento' holograma (road-tax-mx-tvazteca-verificacion). Thin: the hybrid exemption is read from news reports; the Código Fiscal text was not found, and whether hybrids pay the refrendo was not checked.

measured_for: Costa Rica, whole country (property-tax part of the marchamo; the same everywhere)
note: Impuesto a la propiedad de vehículos (Ley 7088 art. 9 as amended by Ley 10390), 2026 scale: 23,100 minimum to 220,000, then 0.60%, 1.80%, 2.10%, 2.50%, 2.80%, 3.15%, 3.50% on each slice. Depreciation by model age 0-7: 0, 10.3, 20.3, 29.8, 38.7, 46.5, 53.3, 59.3%. Base = the car module's price 21,063,128 CRC (the law uses the customs value for a new car, which is lower, so this overstates year 1). Mean of the 8 yearly taxes = 359,117. Left out: the compulsory SOA insurance (30,238 CRC) and the other small marchamo lines (timbres, fees); the roadworthiness test (RTV) fee, because the operator changed in 2026 and no current tariff was found. Thin.

measured_for: Lima (SAT Lima; the same national rate applies in every province)
note: Impuesto al patrimonio vehicular: 1% of the purchase value (never below the MEF table), for only the first 3 years after first registration = 0.01 x 113,231 = 1,132 a year for 3 years, nothing after. Roadworthiness test (CITV): first from the 4th year, then yearly, 80-95 PEN (road-tax-pe-gob-citv: S/ 80-95; first test from the 4th year, road-tax-pe-gob-citv-primera): 4 tests in 8 years at 87.50. (3 x 1,132 + 350) / 8 = 468 a year. The base uses the car module's price in soles, not an invoice.
quote: La tasa del impuesto es el 1% de la base imponible.

measured_for: Medellín (Antioquia: the national rates apply; the department keeps 80%, the municipality 20%)
note: Impuesto vehicular 2026 (Decreto 1457/2025): 1.5% up to 57,349,000 COP, 2.5% up to 129,032,000, 3.5% above, on the Ministry of Transport's base value. Base = the car module's price 170,891,700 COP on a straight line to 50% at year 8, so the rate falls from 3.5% to 2.5% in year 5; mean tax 4,112,082 a year. Plus the technical-mechanical inspection: first from the 5th year, then yearly; 317,728-368,453 COP for a 3-7 year old car (mid 343,090): 3 tests in 8 years = 128,659 a year (road-tax-co-semana-rtm; first test at 5 years: road-tax-co-caracol-rtm). Compulsory SOAT is left out. Thin: the Ministry's actual base value for the Corolla hybrid was not read.

measured_for: São Paulo state (IPVA 4%; licensing fee 174.08 BRL)
note: IPVA 4% of the valor venal (Sefaz-SP's FIPE-based table) + annual licensing fee 174.08 BRL (Detran-SP). Valor venal = the car module's price 196,274 BRL on a straight line to 50% at year 8, mean 153,339 -> IPVA 6,134. Real FIPE values fall faster in the first years, so this is a ceiling. The DPVAT insurance is no longer charged. Thin: base assumed.

measured_for: Santa Catarina state (IPVA 2%; Florianópolis); licensing fee not included
note: IPVA 2% of the valor venal (Sefaz-SC, FIPE-based). Valor venal as for São Paulo, mean 153,339 -> 3,067. Santa Catarina gives no discount for paying in one go. The Detran-SC licensing fee (about 100 BRL) was not read, so it is missing here. Thin: base assumed.
quote: 2% para carros e utilitários nacionais ou estrangeiros

measured_for: Chile, whole country scale (permiso de circulación paid to Santiago's commune; communes keep it, rate is national)
note: Permiso de circulación: 1% of the SII tasación up to 60 UTM, 2% to 120, 3% to 250, 4% to 400, 4.5% above (UTM 72,440 CLP, Nov 2026). Tasación: year 1 the net invoice (price 28,487,617 CLP / 1.19), then the car module's price on a straight line; mean permiso 558,993 a year. Plug-in hybrids get 25% of the tax; ordinary hybrids pay in full. Revisión técnica: since mid-2026 the first one is at 36-48 months, then yearly: 5 in 8 years at about 18,000 CLP (an aggregator's average; plants set their own price) = 11,250 a year. The SOAP insurance is left out. Thin: tasación path assumed.

measured_for: Uruguay, whole country (SUCIVE collects the same patente for every department; Montevideo)
note: Patente de rodados: a new car pays 5% of its value without VAT in its first year, a used one 4.5% of the 'valor de aforo' (Autodata's reference value, roughly market value). Base = the car module's price 1,347,853 UYU, year 1 net of 22% VAT, years 2-8 on a straight line; mean before discounts 46,709. Paying the whole year in January gives 20% off, so 37,367 a year (10% off if paid by instalment on time: 42,038). No periodic inspection for private cars was found. Thin: aforo path assumed.

measured_for: Panama City (Alcaldía de Panamá annual circulation tax)
note: Impuesto anual de circulación for a private car: 28 PAB (Telemetro, undated). The annual 'revisado vehicular' (ATTT) is also needed to collect the sticker and its fee, and the plate/sticker charges, were not found, so the true figure is higher. Thin: a single undated press line.
quote: Municipio aclara que impuesto de circulación para autos particulares seguirá siendo de B/.28.00

measured_for: Ontario (passenger vehicles; the plate sticker fee was abolished in 2022)
note: Ontario charges no annual plate renewal fee for passenger cars (automatic renewal, no sticker, no fee). There is no periodic safety inspection for a private car. Insurance is excluded. Other provinces were not checked.
quote: you will not have to pay a fee

measured_for: New South Wales (excluding the CTP green slip)
note: Registration fee 84 AUD + vehicle tax for private use, tare 1,151-1,500 kg, 391 AUD = 475 a year (page figures before the 2.65% rise on 1 July 2026 and the one-off 100 AUD discount from September 2026). No periodic inspection for a car under 5 years; CTP insurance is excluded. Other states were not checked (Victoria charges more because its TAC levy is in the fee).
